Variants.Content: Torrhen Square is a square castle in the western part of the North, traditionally associated with House Stark. It is not a throne center like Winterfell, but a pragmatic nail in the vast territory of the North: controlling nearby roads, rallying local soldiers, and providing order behind stone walls for merchants and farmers in times of unrest. The distance to the north often makes secondary castles particularly important - there may be days of snowy roads, forests or wilderness between the two cities, so news is slow to arrive, and reinforcements are even slower to come. The square layout and western location of Toruń’s square city gave it stable value in the local defense network. Who is temporarily in charge of the city gates can change, but the fact that the western part of the north requires roads, supplies, and shelter does not change.

Entry Torrhen's Square Local families also rely on firewood, hunting grounds, peat, salt fish, and granaries to survive the long winter; if any road, well, spring, or wharf fails, the price will fall on them first.

Entry Torrhen's Square If you can supply supplies, avoid danger, and find a guide, it is worth marking in your itinerary; if you don't have these three things, no matter how loud your family name is, it won't be able to save the lost.
Entry Torrhen's Square A stronghold was therefore not just a lord's hall, but also a place where weddings and funerals, vows, labor and local memories recurred.

Entry Torrhen's Square They care about firewood, hunting grounds, peat, salt fish, and granaries that can survive the long winter. They also care about whether seeds are left after the grain collection and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see coats of arms, they see whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
